description: Create or update a single label on a branch (upsert by key). Provide the key plus any of values (an object of languageCode -> string), status, or tags. Every language in values must be configured on the project, or the call is rejected with unknown_languages. Returns whether the label was created or updated and its resulting stored state. Use this to add a new translation key or change an existing one. Writes to the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

status.description: Optional status string to set on the label.

tags.description: Optional tags to set on the label.

values.description: Per-language values as { languageCode: string }; only configured languages are allowed.

name: upsert_label
title: Create or Update Label
